notes.styleMandate: REDESIGN is the default and the reason people commission this tool. Per-run override lives in run.json and is set by `inspect --keep-styling`, which should only be used when the commissioner explicitly asked to keep the current look.
notes.materialiseWinningDesignSystem: Rewrites the target repo's tokens and superseded design-doctrine files from the winning UI spec BEFORE screens are built. Without this the winner is a JSON file arguing against a tokens module that every component imports.
notes.requireVisualVerificationBeforeAudit: Test suites cannot see layout. A 402px-tall tab pill and a floating button covering the primary CTA both passed 878 unit tests once; only a render caught them.
